reviews.title: Great quality and item design
reviews.body: Great build and quality. Love it.My only reservation and complaint is how it’s shipped. The manufacturer’s box has no padding whatsoever and I had to return the first one ordered because it was dented and bent in shipping. Even the replacement with the Amazon packaging was only a bag to cover the manufacturer’s box. Amazon really should revisit how this item is shipped.Read moreRead less
